containerStructures.name: WINDOW
containerStructures.description: Declares a dialog window or document window containing controls. Requires a label and title string. Opened by OPEN() and event-processed by ACCEPT.
containerStructures.syntax: label WINDOW('title'[, AT(x,y,w,h)][, CENTER][, MDI][, MODAL][, RESIZE][, MAX][, ICON(file)][, FONT(name,size)][, GRAY][, TIMER(n)][, AUTO][, SYSTEM][, STATUS(n)][, DOUBLE|NOFRAME][, TOOLBOX][, MAXIMIZE][, ICONIZE][, COLOR(fg,bg)][, HLP(id)])

params.name: title
params.description: String constant for the window title bar text (PROP:Text)

containerStructures.name: APPLICATION
containerStructures.description: Declares an MDI frame window. The APPLICATION is the top-level container for MDI child windows. Requires a label and title string.
containerStructures.syntax: label APPLICATION('title'[, AT(x,y,w,h)][, CENTER][, MAX][, ICON(file)][, FONT(name,size)][, GRAY][, TIMER(n)][, STATUS(n)][, MAXIMIZE][, ICONIZE][, COLOR(fg,bg)][, HLP(id)])

params.name: title
params.description: String constant for the MDI frame window title bar text (PROP:Text)

containerStructures.name: REPORT
containerStructures.description: Declares a report structure for printed output. Contains DETAIL, HEADER, FOOTER, and FORM bands. Processed by a PRINT loop.
containerStructures.syntax: label REPORT[('jobname')], AT(x,y,w,h)[, FONT(name,size)][, PRE(prefix)][, LANDSCAPE][, PREVIEW(queue)][, PAPER(type)][, COLOR(color)][, THOUS|MM|POINTS]
